bikes_amounts_check.name: bikes_amounts_check
bikes_amounts_check.value: ("bikes"."purchase_price_cents" is null or "bikes"."purchase_price_cents" >= 0) and ("bikes"."weight_g" is null or "bikes"."weight_g" > 0) and "bikes"."initial_distance_m" >= 0 and "bikes"."initial_wear_s" >= 0

components_removal_check.name: components_removal_check
components_removal_check.value: ("components"."removed_at" is null and "components"."removal_reason" is null and "components"."removal_note" is null) or ("components"."removed_at" is not null and "components"."removal_reason" is not null and "components"."removed_at" >= "components"."installed_at")

maintenance_items_replaced_check.name: maintenance_items_replaced_check
maintenance_items_replaced_check.value: ("maintenance_items"."action" = 'replaced' and "maintenance_items"."component_id" is not null and "maintenance_items"."new_component_id" is not null) or ("maintenance_items"."action" <> 'replaced' and "maintenance_items"."new_component_id" is null)

maintenance_rules_interval_check.name: maintenance_rules_interval_check
maintenance_rules_interval_check.value: ("maintenance_rules"."interval_distance_m" is not null or "maintenance_rules"."interval_wear_s" is not null or "maintenance_rules"."interval_days" is not null) and ("maintenance_rules"."interval_distance_m" is null or "maintenance_rules"."interval_distance_m" > 0) and ("maintenance_rules"."interval_wear_s" is null or "maintenance_rules"."interval_wear_s" > 0) and ("maintenance_rules"."interval_days" is null or "maintenance_rules"."interval_days" > 0)

maintenance_rules_slot_check.name: maintenance_rules_slot_check
maintenance_rules_slot_check.value: "maintenance_rules"."component_type_code" is not null or "maintenance_rules"."position" is null

rides_duration_check.name: rides_duration_check
rides_duration_check.value: "rides"."total_time_s" is not null or "rides"."moving_time_s" is not null

rides_values_check.name: rides_values_check
rides_values_check.value: ("rides"."distance_m" is null or "rides"."distance_m" >= 0) and ("rides"."descent_distance_m" is null or "rides"."descent_distance_m" >= 0) and ("rides"."total_time_s" is null or "rides"."total_time_s" > 0) and ("rides"."moving_time_s" is null or "rides"."moving_time_s" > 0) and ("rides"."descent_time_s" is null or "rides"."descent_time_s" > 0) and ("rides"."runs_count" is null or "rides"."runs_count" >= 0) and ("rides"."elevation_gain_m" is null or "rides"."elevation_gain_m" >= 0) and ("rides"."elevation_loss_m" is null or "rides"."elevation_loss_m" >= 0)

rides_descent_check.name: rides_descent_check
rides_descent_check.value: "rides"."descent_time_s" is null or "rides"."total_time_s" is null or "rides"."descent_time_s" <= "rides"."total_time_s"

rule_templates_interval_check.name: rule_templates_interval_check
rule_templates_interval_check.value: ("rule_templates"."interval_distance_m" is not null or "rule_templates"."interval_wear_s" is not null or "rule_templates"."interval_days" is not null) and ("rule_templates"."interval_distance_m" is null or "rule_templates"."interval_distance_m" > 0) and ("rule_templates"."interval_wear_s" is null or "rule_templates"."interval_wear_s" > 0) and ("rule_templates"."interval_days" is null or "rule_templates"."interval_days" > 0)

rule_templates_code_check.name: rule_templates_code_check
rule_templates_code_check.value: ("rule_templates"."workspace_id" is null and "rule_templates"."code" is not null) or ("rule_templates"."workspace_id" is not null and "rule_templates"."code" is null)
